releases.displayName: Major Update – Tin Can is Now Officially Available in VR

items.text: VR support is included for all owners at no additional cost.
When you launch the game on Steam, you can now select VR mode directly from the launch options.
No separate download required — just choose VR and jump in.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37799723/c1d74394252899a8e63e36ff445f238e02d4b07e.jpg"]
Bringing Tin Can to VR has been a significant technical milestone for us.

notes.title: As with any VR release, behavior may vary depending on

items.text: * Headset model
* Runtime (SteamVR / OpenXR, etc.)
* CPU / GPU configuration
* Play space setup
We’ve tested across multiple configurations, but real-world setups always reveal additional edge cases.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37799723/cc6702b415fee939ba2aaa8a6f9481acb5c5ee9f.png"]

notes.title: If you encounter issues, please include

items.text: * Headset + runtime
* System specs (CPU / GPU)
* Clear reproduction steps
* Logs if available
Structured reports help us track down and fix problems much faster.
Performance feedback and UX suggestions are also highly appreciated.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37799723/58d61f67f669a492c1fccc40983b36d787adfa41.png"]
If the VR version stabilizes well over the coming months, we’re considering a **Meta Quest port.**
No timeline to share yet, but it’s something we’d like to pursue.
This is a major step for Tin Can, and we’re excited to see you finally experience the pod in VR.
Good luck out there
Julien & Clément

Hello fellow astronauts!
We just released the update 0.0.66!
Face new challenges with the addition of fire and leaks!

Sparks will eventually turn into flames, depending on the amount of oxygen and carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, as well as pressure. Flames will convert O2 in CO2, and generate heat, and will slowly destroy affected components! You'll have to grab your fire extinguisher and act quickly! Or you could just open the airlock...

Leaks will show up from time to time, whether because of a space collision or if you are not careful with your pod's internal pressure. You'll have to react quickly to locate them and fix them to avoid losing your atmosphere!
The update also brings new storage drawers! Some random components will be placed inside every single time you start a game as a little extra to make it a bit further.
Various other improvements have been made since the last update. If you are interested in the full list you can go and take a look at the changelog in the Steam discussion thread.
We are now focusing on the next update : Rescue Mode!

Rescue mode will finally allow you to avoid death, if you can make it far enough. A rescue ship will eventually find you and get you to safety, away from your badly designed pod. You will also be able to start the game before your initial ship's explosion, giving you a limited amount of time to do a diagnostic of your pod and to collect whatever components you can get your hands on.
We can't wait for you guys to try it out!
See you out there in space!
The Tin Can Team

Hello fellow Tinnies,

The game has now been released for a couple weeks and we've been hard at work fixing the early bugs you have reported, balancing the game and adding a much needed option menu (with also volume and FOV sliders and inverted mouse) as well as random events for the hardcore mode.

We are now working on adding more languages to the game, a basic tutorial, more debug and then we'll start working on Rescue Mode and Storage Spaces. Do not hesitate to come and give us feedback on the update on discord : https://discord.gg/pqyVX53RUj (And come take a look at the roadmap)!
Leaderboard has been reset, so now is your time to shine :O !
